dataset_title: Okapi Wildlife Reserve monthly gross greenhouse-gas emissions data status

spatial_scope.name: Okapi Wildlife Reserve
spatial_scope.geometry_applied: Reserve polygon; no external buffer included

interpretation: Emission values are unknown, not zero. All three requested emission fields are deliberately blank for every month because the available satellite observations do not constitute measured greenhouse-gas flux or a validated activity-data × emission-factor inventory.

gross_emissions_co2e_all_gases__Mg.definition: Gross emissions from all included greenhouse gases, expressed as carbon-dioxide equivalent for the specified month and reserve polygon. Null means not quantifiable from evidence reviewed; it is not zero.

gross_emissions_co2e_non_co2__Mg.definition: Gross non-CO2 emissions (for example CH4 and N2O, if included by the documented inventory boundary) expressed as CO2e. Null means not quantifiable; no RFO-specific gas flux/activity data and factors were available.

gross_emissions_co2e_co2_only__Mg.definition: Gross CO2 emissions only for the specified month and reserve polygon. Null means not quantifiable; no validated emission event area, carbon-stock loss, or combustion estimate was available.

data_status.definition: The reporting month was assessed but no defensible gross-emissions amount can be calculated from the data reviewed.

satellite_observation_columns.definition: Contextual scene counts and Sentinel-2 vegetation indices for that month. These are not emission factors, event areas, or flux measurements.

satellite_data_inventory.coverage: 666 STAC items intersecting reserve query; 60 least-cloudy tile-month scenes processed, six MGRS tiles per month
satellite_data_inventory.measurement_use: 100 m cloud-masked monthly NDVI/EVI mosaics; vegetation-condition context only
satellite_data_inventory.limitation: NDVI/EVI do not identify or quantify emitted carbon; no validated change-to-emissions model was applied.
No Landsat raster metrics or disturbance areas processed.
No backscatter, disturbance areas, or biomass changes processed.

satellite_data_inventory.coverage: 9 CMR granule footprints intersect reserve, Jan-Mar
satellite_data_inventory.limitation: Measurement HDF5 files and waveforms were not processed; footprints are not emissions.
Measurement rasters were not processed; radar backscatter is not directly an emissions estimate.

satellite_data_inventory.coverage: 315 granules returned by surrounding-box query; zero returned footprint polygons intersected reserve
satellite_data_inventory.limitation: Atmospheric XCO2 sampling is not a reserve-scale gross flux measurement.

satellite_data_inventory.coverage: 219 granules returned by surrounding-box query; zero returned footprint polygons intersected reserve
satellite_data_inventory.limitation: Atmospheric XCO2 sampling is not a reserve-scale gross flux measurement.

satellite_data_inventory.coverage: No 2026 intersecting granules found in queried CMR collections
satellite_data_inventory.limitation: No matching local retrievals identified; atmospheric concentration is not reserve-scale gross flux.

satellite_data_inventory.coverage: No 2026 granules; queried CMR collection ends in 2020
satellite_data_inventory.limitation: No reporting-period data found in queried collection.

satellite_data_inventory.coverage: Mission data access opened in 2026; no RFO acquisition was queried or processed
satellite_data_inventory.limitation: Mission availability is not evidence of an RFO acquisition or measured gas flux.

calculation_method.current: No monthly gross-emissions values are calculated. The requested fields remain null rather than inserting zero or applying an unsupported conversion from vegetation indices to flux.
required_for_quantification: Validate monthly disturbed/burned/conversion area against optical and radar time series and reference data.
Determine affected land-use/pool transitions and pre-disturbance carbon stocks with appropriate biomass/soil datasets and field or validated model support.
Apply DRC- and ecosystem-appropriate emission factors with explicit carbon pools, combustion/decay, and uncertainty.
Quantify CH4 and N2O where applicable using activity data and appropriate factors; convert gases to CO2e using an explicitly cited IPCC assessment basis and time horizon.
Document gross accounting boundary; prevent double-counting between CO2-only and non-CO2 components; reconcile all-gases total.

citation: NASA CMR and Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog metadata; see per-sensor source URLs and limitations. Satellite data availability and vegetation-condition indices are not direct greenhouse-gas flux measurements.
